description: Write the tenant's Power Platform configuration to local files for reference, diffing and source control: tenant settings, environments, DLP policies, environment groups, service principals, registered applications and app templates, plus per environment its details, solutions, agents, connections, security roles and platform backups. Read-only for the tenant; it only writes files. Runs as the admin account: pass 'profile' or set CPS_ADMIN_PROFILE. Each capture is independent, so a command the account cannot run is reported in 'skipped' and the rest still completes.

clientId.description: Entra app (client) id for MSAL. Defaults to CPS_CLIENT_ID, then the first-party VS Code id.

dir.description: Folder to write the backup into (created; existing files with the same names are overwritten)

environments.description: Environments to detail; default: every environment 'pac admin list' returns

includeBackups.description: Default true: the platform backups of each environment

includeDataverse.description: Default true: flows, connection references, environment variables and agents per environment, when a Dataverse sign-in is cached (cs_login)

includeEnvironments.description: Default true; false captures tenant level only

includeRoles.description: Default true: the security roles of each environment

profile.description: pac auth profile of the admin account; default CPS_ADMIN_PROFILE, then the active profile

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id. Defaults to the workspace sync metadata, then CPS_TENANT_ID.

name: cs_backup_tenant
title: Back up the tenant configuration to files
